units.source_text: 站前的一爿小旅馆，门前挂着"海水浴旅馆由良馆"的招牌，我想就在这旅馆泊宿。

en.t: In front of the station stood a small inn, with a sign at the entrance reading "Seaside Bathing Inn Yurakan," and I thought I would spend the night there.

units.source_text: 打开了毛玻璃门，扬声请求向导，却不见回应。

en.t: I opened the frosted glass door and called out for someone to show me in, but there was no answer.

units.source_text: 正门铺板上落满了厚厚的灰尘，木板套窗紧闭，屋内一片漆黑，没有人的动静。

en.t: The floorboards of the front entrance were covered with a thick layer of dust, the wooden shutters were tightly closed, and inside it was pitch-dark, with no sign of anyone.
